info.title: Continuing Education prototype API
info.description: Local synthetic data only. Authentication is a prototype token adapter, not production SSO. Payment uses the Stripe sandbox when configured, otherwise a simulation; enrollment is simulated.

email.description: Mock sign-in only; no password accepted.

saved.description: true to save the course, false to remove it

following.description: true to follow the pathway, false to stop; following registers nothing

startDate.description: Required for cohort courses; omit for self-paced courses.

endDate.description: Required for cohort courses; omit for self-paced courses.

approvalValidDays.description: Days an approval stays valid before the learner must reserve.

enrollmentCloseDays.description: Scheduled courses: days after the start date when enrollment closes.

canvasCourseUrl.description: HTTPS link to the mapped Canvas course.

startDate.description: Required for cohort courses; omit for self-paced courses.

endDate.description: Required for cohort courses; omit for self-paced courses.

approvalValidDays.description: Days an approval stays valid before the learner must reserve.

enrollmentCloseDays.description: Scheduled courses: days after the start date when enrollment closes.

canvasCourseUrl.description: HTTPS link to the mapped Canvas course.

reason.description: Required (10–500 characters) when the offering is published; recorded in the audit log.

canvasCourseUrl.description: HTTPS link to the mapped Canvas course; null removes it.

page.description: { blocks: [...], seo: { title, description } }; block types hero, text, outcomes, instructor, testimonial, faq

revision.description: Published revision to copy into the draft

slug.description: Public URL segment; derived from the title when omitted

offeringIds.description: Offering IDs in display order; for pathways, the recommended order

provisioningOutcome.description: PROTOTYPE ONLY: outcome applied to provisioning queued after this change.

reason.description: Why staff are taking this action; recorded in the audit log.

active.description: true to reactivate, false to deactivate
